
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(zoo)
library(dplyr)

# Import Data
data_fama_french_factors <- read_excel("FAMA French 3 Factors monthly 2020.xlsx")

data_return <- read_excel("WMT-AAPL-MCD-return-data.xlsx")

# Create variables and delete unnecessary variables
data_fama_french_factors = data_fama_french_factors[, -1]

data_return$date = as.yearmon(as.Date(data_return$date))

data_fama_french_factors$date = unique(data_return$date)

# Merge data
reg_data <- data_return %>%
  left_join(data_fama_french_factors, by = "date")

reg_data$excess_r_it = reg_data$r_it - reg_data$RF

# Run the regression
firm_names = unique(reg_data$ticker)

for (i in firm_names){
  
  famma_french_model = lm(formula = excess_r_it ~ `Mkt-RF` + SMB + HML, data = reg_data[reg_data$ticker == i, ])
  
  cat("Results for", i, ":\n")
  print(summary(famma_french_model))
  cat("\n")
}
```
